r3s2 · IC-stack

IC-stack: B1 0.92x, B2 repaired 0.72x — round’s best

Condition vector
→
FiLM-FNO coarse-field synthesis
→
Certified per-dataset interpolation lift
→
Frozen CNN corrector
  • Stage 1 uses 4 spectral blocks, width 64, 12 Fourier modes; trained on ~400 condition → coarse-field pairs per sharp dataset.
  • Batch-2 repair: leave-one-out ridge plus a hard band-limit at the coarse grid’s Nyquist frequency, fixing a 66x spectral amplification fitted from 3 samples.
  • Stream reference-to-beat improved 12.96 → 10.09 in registered units.
  • Established: initial-condition information is the entire measurable effect and acts in stage 1; the corrector adds nothing resolvable.
  • Nuance: stack versus matched direct route holds at panel level by 1.62, 3.2x the minimum claimable effect, sign-stable at every seed; one instrument-acceptance clause was falsified.

r3s3 · LF-value contrast

LF-value: 0.79x film; best on ifc_heat and fisher_kpp

  • One multi-resolution conditioned FNO: 4 spectral blocks, width 64, with Fourier modes pinned to the coarsest rung’s Nyquist.
  • Shared spectral basis and backbone; per-rung output heads; joint loss predicts the coarse solve at every rung and the fine field, equally weighted.
  • ~400 coarse rows versus as few as 5 fine rows. At test, only the fine head is read out.
  • Confirmed supply/coverage mechanism: covered-only control learns the same function as no-LF; function-distance ratios 0.098–0.307.
  • New condition rows explain E_cov/E_total in [0.972, 1.024] in 30/30 evaluated cases; recovery tracks condition-response alignment at Pearson r = 0.985.
  • Retracted: the -10.1% pre-repair headline was entirely a stale-baseline artifact. After repair, panel change was -0.81%, 0.08x the certified minimum detectable effect.

r3s2-B1 · IC-reach stack

0.92x film, with an important confidence-interval caveat

Observed result

Panel geomean 12.9556, with 3-seed range [10.32, 17.83].

Its 0.92 confidence interval crosses 1.0: this is a mean-level win only, not a certified beat.

F1 confirmed

Initial-condition information helps in stage 1.

F2 falsified

The corrective stage is unresolvable, replicating round 2’s null.

Fake-IC control

A fake, information-free initial condition performs worse than no initial condition on every dataset. The benefit comes from information in the real initial conditions, not the extra input channel.

Instruments and rails

Reliability became a measured, binding part of the factory

Certifier: 1.40x

An instrument, not a contender. It established the certified minimum-detectable-effect table.

The train_seconds heuristic found 0 unique true positives and 62 false alarms across 859 runs; it is being deleted in favor of content hashes stored in checkpoints.

Six-role binding instrument

108/108 on a labelled fixture: perfect recall 27/27, 18/18, 18/18; 0/27 false “retrain” verdicts.

Now a hard gate in every anchor build.

Stale-checkpoint repair

Pre-repair weights were evaluated on post-repair arrays. 32 runs were quarantined and retrained.

G5 fit-set seam

Re-priced in closed form and adopted by the operator; below the claim threshold on all 5 affected cells. Every affected margin widened; no verdict flipped.

Stop-the-line events

pfc no-fidelity-gap discovery: 2026-08-07.

Stale-checkpoint contamination: 2026-08-08.

Repair consumed ~2 of batch 1’s ~5 days.

Batch 3 and next

Two final cards, then round close

r3s3-B3

Sealed knee predictions + 4-rung ladder

Can a training-free surrogate predict each dataset’s sample-efficiency knee? Predictions were sealed with sha256 + timestamp before training; a 4-rung training ladder adjudicates.

Seed 0 complete: job 261111, 2 h 09 m. Chance match is 1/3 per adjudicable cell, so only the joint pattern carries evidence.

r3s2-B3

5-rung oracle-ceiling ladder

How much could the coarse-field detour ever buy? The oracle rung feeds the corrector the real coarse field: a ceiling, not an alternative model, because it cannot be deployed at test time.

Seed 0 is relaunching after a guardrail stopped a floor-fitting protocol mismatch on a guard dataset; scored panel cells are unaffected.
